# Troubleshooting {#sec-troubleshooting}

Start with `grep -A 15 "Error in rule" RNApipeCore-*.out` to find which rule
failed, then read `output/logs/{rule}_{sample}.err` and the job's SLURM log.

## The run won't start

| Message | Likely cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `KeyError: 'Read1'` (or another column) | Samplesheet isn't tab-separated, or the header is misspelled | `cat -A RNAsamplesheet.txt \| head -2`: columns must be separated by `^I` |
| `KeyError: 'salmon'` / `'hisat2'` / `'gtf'` | Reference lines still commented out in `RNAconfig.yaml` | Uncomment one block ([Running](../rna-seq/running-rnapipe.qmd#choose-the-reference)) |
| `Directory cannot be locked` | A previous run was killed | `./unlock.sh rna`, then rerun |
| `MissingInputException` | A FASTQ path is wrong | Check `Sequencing_Directory` ends in `/` or that `Read1`/`Read2` names are exact (`ls` them) |
| `module: command not found` / module not found | No module system (laptop), or that version isn't installed on your cluster | On a cluster: `module avail <tool>` and update the `*Vers` key. bagPipes needs a cluster with modules ([Running the pipeline](../rna-seq/running-rnapipe.qmd)) |
| `command not found` for `salmon`, `fastqc`, ... in a Try-it box | conda environment not active | `conda activate rnaseq-tools` |
| `$DATA` is empty / `No such file` for practice files | Shortcuts not loaded in this terminal | `source ~/omics-walkthru-practice/env.sh` |
| `FileNotFoundError: output/...Samplesheet.txt` | `output/` doesn't exist (only in dry runs by hand) | `mkdir -p output` |

## A step fails

| Rule | Symptom | Likely cause |
|---|---|---|
| `fastqc`, `trim` | `mv: cannot stat ...` | Two rows share a sample name, or the FASTQ doesn't end in `.fastq.gz` |
| `trim` | `gzip: unexpected end of file` | Truncated FASTQ (incomplete copy). Check with `gzip -t` and `md5sum` |
| `quant` | Out of memory / killed | Index too large for 20 GB; raise `mem_mb_per_cpu` in the rule |
| `quant` | Very low mapping rate, but it runs | Wrong species index, rRNA, or total RNA ([Salmon](../rna-seq/salmon.qmd)) |
| `align` | `Could not locate a HISAT2 index` | `hisat2:` must be the index **prefix**, not the folder |
| `signal` | `bamCoverage` error about index | `.bai` missing or older than the BAM; rerun `align` |
| `tximport` | `None of the transcripts in the quantification files are present in tx2gene` | Salmon index and GTF from different releases, or ID format mismatch |
| `multiqc` | Report is missing a tool | That tool's logs were deleted or named unexpectedly; check `output/` |

## The results look wrong

| What you see | What to check |
|---|---|
| Strand tracks reversed (*GAPDH* in `_rev`) | Library is read-1-sense, not dUTP; Salmon `lib_format_counts.json` should say `ISF` |
| Strand tracks identical | Unstranded library (`IU`); set `stranded: False` |
| One sample unlike its replicates in PCA | Samplesheet labels, then that sample's MultiQC rows |
| tximport matrix columns named `NA` | Known issue in `txImporter.R`; set column names from the copied samplesheet ([tximport](../rna-seq/tximport.qmd)) |
| Tracks differ in height between samples | bagPipes' tracks are not depth-normalised ([Signal tracks](../rna-seq/signal-tracks.qmd)) |
| No FastQC files in `output/QC` | They're `temp()`; the numbers are in MultiQC |
